children.title: Monitor DNS propagation
children.summary:
When you use the Google Cloud CLI or the REST API to make changes, the changes are initially
marked as pending until the operation is completed.

children.title: List changes for a managed zone
children.summary:
To list changes for a managed zone, run the dns record-sets changes list
(/sdk/gcloud/reference/dns/record-sets/changes/list) command.

children.title: Verify DNS propagation
children.summary:
To monitor and verify that the DNS name server has picked up your changes, you can use the
watch and dig commands.
